item.title: Students using AI to cheat will face stricter rules, says Danish government
item.summary: Teenagers must make oral defence of essays and schools will monitor computers during exams under crackdown Europe live – latest updates Danish teenagers will have to make an oral defence of their written essays to combat AI cheating, the government has announced. Pupils aged 16 to 19 at upper secondary school (known in Denmark as gymnasiet ) will also be encouraged to do written assignments at school under controlled conditions, including monitoring of their computer screens, rather than at home.
